title: Improper input validation in Bixby prior to version 4.0.85.6 allows privileged local attackers to… (CVE-2026-21157)
description: An improper input validation vulnerability in Bixby versions prior to 4.0.85.6 allows privileged local attackers to launch arbitrary activities. This flaw affects local users with elevated privileges and can lead to unauthorized activity execution. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 8.3. No known exploits in the wild have been reported. The issue is fixed starting from version 4.0.85.6.
